newsitem.title: CANADA: Renata climbs after big Alberta gas find.
newsitem.headline: Renata climbs after big Alberta gas find.

text.p: Shares in junior oil firm Renata Resources Inc climbed in busy volume on Friday after a Talisman Energy Inc gas prospect, in which Renata has a stake, was deemed a major discovery.
Renata, the Toronto Stock Exchange's second most active issue on Friday, was up 0.06 to 1.94 on 1.8 million shares.
Talisman was down 0.15 to 43.80 on almost 87,000 shares in Toronto.
The company has a 30 percent stake in Talisman's Apetowun well in Alberta's Edson region, which recently flowed at a test rate of 52.8 million cubic feet a day.
The well was drilled to a depth of 4,461 metres and encountered a new pinnacle reef, Talisman said on Thursday.
Its initial production rate when tied in midway through 1998 was expected to be 25 million to 30 million cubic feet a day.
